defect: The fix moves the fboTexNeedBind shader-blend texture binding out of ApplyDrawStateLate into a separate BindShaderBlendTex so it no longer overwrites the normal texture binding.
reason: This change only replaced the vkCmd* calls with VulkanRenderManager calls; the fboTexNeedBind block was commented-out context here and was re-enabled by a later commit, so the binding-order defect was not introduced by it.

defect: The BIND_GRAPHICS_PIPELINE case reads the pipeline layout through the wrong union member c.pipeline instead of c.graphics_pipeline, whose pipelineLayout sits at a different offset on 32-bit builds.
reason: The c.pipeline.pipelineLayout access was already in the parent (wrong since dbe395dd00 made pipelineLayout a pointer the day before); this change only rewrote the line to reach frameData and kept the pre-existing wrong member.

defect: The fix adds a feature: it remembers the last crash address and lets the user resume by ignoring later faults at that address.
reason: Feature addition on top of the split-out fault handler, not a repair of anything this change introduced.

defect: The fix adds a Resume button for runtime-error crashes and reformats OnChat and the visibility line.
reason: Feature; the onScreenMessagesView_ visibility line added by this change is only reformatted, not corrected.

defect: The fix corrects the wording of two input-box prompts ('a IP' to 'an IP', 'Mac' to 'MAC').
reason: Cosmetic text change in UI prompt strings with no functional effect.

defect: The fix casts uncomp_size to int in the decompressed-size mismatch check to silence a signed/unsigned comparison warning.
reason: Warning cleanup; the comparison behaves the same for any valid size.

defect: The fix casts -1 to u32 in the atlasPtr != -1 allocation check to silence a sign-compare warning.
reason: The comparison already converted -1 to 0xFFFFFFFF, so behaviour is unchanged; warning cleanup only.

defect: The fix casts -1 to u32 in the vaddr == -1 allocation-failure check to silence a sign-compare warning.
reason: vaddr is unsigned, so the comparison already worked; warning cleanup only.

defect: The fix changes the blacklist loop index from int to size_t to silence a sign-compare warning against ARRAY_SIZE.
reason: Warning cleanup with no behavioural effect on a three-element array.

defect: The fix reorders the ADSREnvelope constructor initializer list to match member declaration order (-Wreorder).
reason: The members are initialized with constants, so the order has no effect; warning cleanup.

defect: The fix reverts this change's crash-investigation instrumentation (zero-address checks and debug asserts) in Execute_FramebufPtr and Execute_ZbufPtr after the crash was traced to Accessible() in x64Emitter.h.
reason: getFrameBufAddress/getDepthBufAddress always include the 0x44000000 base, so the added checks were dead debug code; the real repair is in another file and nothing broken here is fixed.

defect: The fix copies float positions into the temp buffer instead of pointing verts at the game's vertex data, because later code transforms verts in place.
reason: verts = vdata predates this change (it was verts = control_points, only renamed here) and was harmless while verts was read-only; the in-place world transform that would corrupt guest memory was added by later culling commits.

defect: The change enables the fog bit at bit 9 of the fragment shader ID, overlapping the 3-bit alpha test function stored at bits 9-11, so shaders with and without fog can collide on one ID.
reason: The fix moves the fog bit to 12; the colliding shift was written in this change, directly below the alpha-test line that uses bits 9-11.

defect: The fix adds a combined fog-and-not-through-and-not-clear bit to the vertex shader ID and removes the unused shadeLight0/shadeLight1 locals.
reason: At this change the generator used isFogEnabled directly, which was already bit 2 of the ID; the clear-mode-dependent enableFog was introduced later (7271e3fcd5), and the unused locals only cause a warning.

defect: The fix adds HTML ampersand unescaping to GetQuotedStrings for streaming server listings.
reason: This change only replaced push_back with emplace_back; the missing escape handling predates it and the fix is a feature.

defect: The change passed timeoutPtr to the sceKernelWaitThreadEndCB DEBUG_LOG without a matching format specifier; the fix adds the specifier.
reason: An extra variadic argument is ignored and harmless; this is a log-message and warning fix, not a functional defect.

defect: The fix changes the Blackberry QWERTY device-name check from 'Blackberry10:QWERTY' to 'Blackberry:QWERTY'.
reason: When this change was made, native's System_GetProperty(SYSPROP_NAME) used the 'Blackberry10:' prefix; native renamed it to 'Blackberry:' on 2013-11-26 (16b69fb583), so the mismatch came from that later change.

defect: The fix lets Core_NextFrame accept CORE_STEPPING_CPU as well as CORE_RUNNING_CPU and logs unexpected states.
reason: This change was a pure rename of CORE_RUNNING to CORE_RUNNING_CPU; the running-only check existed before it.

defect: The fix fakes the fontlib allocation instead of calling the game's alloc function (which fails in Dissidia) and tracks open fonts in isfontopen_ instead of guest memory.
reason: Calling the guest alloc and writing to the returned memory predates this change; the Done() edit only follows from the hack's fake addresses.

defect: The change added the 1/32768 fixed-point scaling (UCVTF fbits 15) to Jit_TcU16Prescale instead of Jit_TcU16ToFloat, wrongly rescaling prescaled U16 texcoords and leaving the ToFloat path unscaled.
reason: The fix moves the argument to the intended function; the diff itself shows U8ToFloat getting fbits 7 while U16Prescale, not U16ToFloat, gets 15.

defect: The fix adds AA3 error codes and size checks, corrects the AA3 channel count, and returns _AtracSetData's result directly from the *AndGetID functions.
reason: The touched return logic in sceAtracSetMOutDataAndGetID is the same as before this change; the fix targets the later AA3 handling and changed _AtracSetData semantics.

defect: The fix adds the missing override specifier to SystemInfoScreen::resized().
reason: The method already overrode the virtual base method; this is a compiler-warning fix.

defect: The fix removes an unused this capture from the audio-device OnChoice lambda.
reason: Unused-capture warning cleanup with no behavioural effect.

defect: The change passes log_cb (a function pointer) as userdata, but RetroLogCallback casts userdata to a pointer to a function pointer and dereferences it, calling through garbage and crashing on the first log.
reason: The fix casts userdata directly to retro_log_printf_t; both the registration and the callback are in this diff.

defect: The new snap code subtracts (touch - current center) modulo the grid size, so it only moves the control in grid-size steps relative to its current position and never aligns it to a fixed grid.
reason: The same-day fix replaces the moving reference with a fixed one; the relative formula was written in this change and is evident from the diff.

defect: The change passes achievement->title, a std::string, to a %s variadic log call, which is undefined behaviour (and rejected by clang).
reason: The fix adds .c_str(); seeing that title is a std::string requires the Achievement struct in the header.

defect: The fix makes the pause-toggle and reset shortcuts work from the pause menu and always sets the pause menu text.
reason: Extending the shortcuts to the pause menu is new behaviour; the in-game menu text update added by this change was correct for the in-game case it handled.

defect: The fix reschedules the vtimer with the handler's return value instead of schedule plus the return value.
reason: The parent already computed schedule + delay (via schedule += delay); this change only moved the sum into a local, so the semantics predate it.

defect: The change makes Close() set fontLibID_ to (u32)-1 while GetFontLib() indexes fontLibList[fontLibID_] unconditionally, so calling it on a closed font, as __FontShutdown does, reads out of bounds.
reason: Before the change a closed font returned a null fontLib that __FontShutdown checked; the fix adds the IsOpen guard, and both sides are in this diff.

defect: In the new mtvc VFPU_CTRL_CC path the change emits MOV(gpr.R(MIPS_REG_VFPUCC), rt), using the MIPS register number as an ARM register instead of gpr.R(rt).
reason: The fix uses gpr.R(rt); the mfvc branch just above in the same diff does it correctly.

defect: The fix enforces a minimum 100 us delay for sceIoRead and sceIoReadAsync (and writes) and bases the async delay on bytes read instead of requested size.
reason: This change introduced the result/100 and size/100 delay estimates, marked as approximate; a zero delay still reschedules, and nothing shows whether the tuning repaired a real game failure.

defect: The change switched the Skip Buffer Effects menu item from gpu_resized to gpu_configChanged, which does not trigger NotifyRenderResized/UpdateRenderSize where bSkipBufferEffects is applied, so the toggle had no immediate effect.
reason: The fix sends gpu_renderResized; seeing that configChanged never reaches the framebuffer manager needs NativeApp.cpp and GPUCommon::CheckResized.

defect: The new sceCccEncodeUTF16 returns a pointer that the firmware does not return and encodes out-of-range or surrogate code points instead of substituting the error character.
reason: The fix makes it void and substitutes errorUTF16 for invalid code points; the behaviour was added in this change, but the expected firmware behaviour is not visible from code.

defect: The new ticks branch in getReferenceValue tests REF_INDEX_USEC a second time instead of REF_INDEX_TICKS, so the ticks reference falls through and returns -1.
reason: Copy-paste error in lines this change added; the fix compares with REF_INDEX_TICKS.

defect: The new warning condition 'bc && (w & 3) != 0 || (h & 3) != 0' lacks parentheses, so it also fires for non-block-compressed textures whose height is not a multiple of 4.
reason: The fix adds the parentheses; the precedence error is in both copies of the check this change added.

defect: The new ordering guard swaps when endAddr > startAddr, reversing correctly ordered ranges so lower_bound(start) lies past upper_bound(end) and the loop and erase run over an invalid range (hang).
reason: The fix flips the comparison to <; the inverted test is plainly in this diff.

defect: The fix adds a D3D9 half-pixel offset to the depalettize quad and drops the now-unused indices array.
reason: The missing half-pixel offset predates this change (the old quad had none either), the fix calls itself an approximation, and removing the indices is cleanup.

defect: The fix removes LostBackbuffer() and gpu->DeviceLost() from ContextDestroy because they crash on closing content after the later cached-GPU-pointer cleanup.
reason: The crash follows from the later GPU cleanup (PR 15142, merged two days before the fix) that changed the gpu pointer's lifetime; nothing shows these calls failing when this change was made.

defect: The change uses WZR whenever rt is a known-zero immediate, including for loads, so a load into such an rt targets WZR, discards the loaded value and leaves rt with the stale immediate.
reason: The fix restricts the WZR shortcut to stores; the shared load/store path is visible in the diff.

defect: The change dropped toggle_(toggle) from the ComboKey constructor initializer list, leaving toggle_ uninitialized.
reason: The fix restores the initializer; the removal is directly in this diff.
